messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

The text is the title of a song by the Beatles. Who composed it?

Text: Mean Mr. Mustard

Allowed answers:
- John Lennon
- George Harrison
- Ringo Starr
- Lennon–McCartney

message.reasoning_content: Lennon wrote it, credited Lennon–McCartney. Composition credited to both; but composer question—usually credited Lennon–McCartney on Abbey Road. The song was written by Lennon. Allowed answers include both; pick Lennon–McCartney since credited.
